data: In fiscal 2025, which ended September 27, 2025, Apple reported total net sales of about $416.2 billion, up roughly 6% from $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Gross profit was about $195.2 billion, a gross margin of roughly 46.9%, compared with 46.2% in fiscal 2024. Operating income was about $133.1 billion, an operating margin of roughly 32.0%, up from about 31.5% ($123.2 billion) the year before. Services drove much of the margin gain, with a gross margin in the mid-70% range compared with the mid-30% range for products. These figures come from my recollection of Apple's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K rather than a live lookup, so you should check them against the filing before relying on exact decimals.
